name: Snivy, The Snake Eye
desc:
If you control a Plant monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Contrary Fusion" from your Deck to your hand.
You can banish 2 Plant monsters from your GY; add 1 Plant monster from your Deck to your hand.
If this card is in the GY while "Contrary Fusion" is in the GY: You can Special Summon this card.
You can only use each effect of "Snivy, The Snake Eye" once per turn.
strings: Banish 2 Plant from GY; add 1 Plant from Deck
